reviews.strongest_objection: Root selection differs across environments and product modes.
reviews.source_limitations: Service inspection does not prove every environment provides every root.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Bundled/system roots can be disabled.
reviews.rationale: Final wording scopes the claim to resolution before metadata loading.

reviews.strongest_objection: Cache reuse could expose stale skill metadata.
reviews.source_limitations: Cache freshness depends on watcher/config invalidation paths.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Separate cwd/config cache maps and explicit clear_cache exist.
reviews.rationale: Inventory describes snapshots as reusable projections and separately documents invalidation.

reviews.strongest_objection: A loader may read enough body content during parsing to appear like injection.
reviews.source_limitations: Loader and injection paths were inspected separately.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Body reads occur in build_skill_injections/extension read paths.
reviews.rationale: Discovery and body injection are distinct in the inspected implementation.

reviews.strongest_objection: Watcher events may be unavailable or delayed.
reviews.source_limitations: No live filesystem event trace was run.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Watcher explicitly clears the service cache on events.
reviews.rationale: Wording limits the claim to observed watcher behavior.

reviews.strongest_objection: A provider trait cannot prove all providers preserve authority correctly.
reviews.source_limitations: Provider implementations are not exhaustively tested here.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Trait documentation and SkillReadRequest carry authority/package/resource together.
reviews.rationale: Wording says operations remain routed through the owner, not that every provider is perfect.

reviews.strongest_objection: Client skills/list and model skills.list have similar names and could share code.
reviews.source_limitations: Wire-level protocol definitions are not repeated in this audit.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Client catalog processor and model ToolExecutor are separate paths.
reviews.rationale: The distinction is based on caller and authority boundary, not spelling alone.

reviews.strongest_objection: A structured path can be stale or point outside the current snapshot.
reviews.source_limitations: Resolution is tested against supplied catalog state.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Selection filters enabled entries and deduplicates paths.
reviews.rationale: Final wording includes the enabled catalog dependency.

reviews.strongest_objection: Plain-name ambiguity and mention syntax can evolve.
reviews.source_limitations: Current parser behavior is pinned to this commit.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Exact path and unambiguous name branches are explicit.
reviews.rationale: Inventory identifies implementation-specific rules and avoids generalizing beyond them.

reviews.strongest_objection: A successful read does not guarantee safe or truthful skill instructions.
reviews.source_limitations: Content semantics are outside the loader.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Read errors become warnings and success creates injection content.
reviews.rationale: Claim concerns authority/read behavior, not instruction safety.

reviews.strongest_objection: Budget accounting may differ by model/tokenizer.
reviews.source_limitations: Renderer uses approximate token/character measures.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Budget and omission/truncation report are explicit.
reviews.rationale: Wording says active budget and does not promise exact provider token equivalence.

reviews.strongest_objection: Extension context can be disabled or vary by environment.
reviews.source_limitations: Not every config branch was executed.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Contributor methods check configuration and store turn state.
reviews.rationale: Final wording is conditional on the extension being enabled.

reviews.strongest_objection: Commands outside the recognized runner/extension set can still execute.
reviews.source_limitations: Detector source explicitly uses a bounded runner list.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: The function returns an optional attribution candidate, not an execution result.
reviews.rationale: The limitation is made central to the final wording.

reviews.strongest_objection: Analytics delivery can fail or be sampled.
reviews.source_limitations: No external telemetry delivery guarantee was inspected.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Per-turn seen-key and metric/analytics calls are present.
reviews.rationale: Inventory calls these observability records, not a guaranteed trace.

reviews.strongest_objection: The model may hallucinate a handle or receive stale catalog data.
reviews.source_limitations: List tool contract does not guarantee subsequent availability.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Handles are bounded and authority-scoped.
reviews.rationale: The claim describes output shape, not eventual read success.

reviews.strongest_objection: Provider reads can return errors or a changed catalog.
reviews.source_limitations: Tool tests do not cover every provider failure.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Read validates package/authority and checks returned resource identity.
reviews.rationale: Final wording includes revalidation and provider routing.

reviews.strongest_objection: Trait contracts do not prove remote provider isolation.
reviews.source_limitations: Provider-specific authority implementations require separate audits.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: The trait explicitly prohibits ambient-path conversion conceptually.
reviews.rationale: Wording identifies the boundary and its implementation-dependent limits.

reviews.strongest_objection: Skills can cause other tool families or remote executors to run commands.
reviews.source_limitations: The evidence is the local unified-exec path.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Detector and executor are separate modules.
reviews.rationale: Final wording scopes execution to the inspected local path and says other executors differ.

reviews.strongest_objection: Approval/sandbox semantics differ for remote tools and connectors.
reviews.source_limitations: Only local unified-exec enforcement is inspected here.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: UnifiedExecRuntime implements approval and sandbox traits.
reviews.rationale: The inventory explicitly scopes the claim to local command execution.

reviews.strongest_objection: Metrics may be the only record for some invocation paths.
reviews.source_limitations: No product-wide persistence matrix was inspected.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Core tool loop has correlated outputs; skill analytics are separate clients.
reviews.rationale: The final wording explicitly denies that observability is a complete durable trace.

reviews.strongest_objection: Warnings can be lost or not shown to a model/client.
reviews.source_limitations: Warning delivery depends on surface and turn path.
reviews.conflicting_evidence: Renderer and extension create warnings/omissions for failure and budget cases.
reviews.rationale: Claim is about explicit failure representation, not guaranteed human observation.
